Robert F. Kennedy Jr. talks with Rogan, in a segment of the Joe Rogan Experience, about suing Monsanto and the dangers he sees in Roundup. Kennedy built his name as an environmental lawyer, and the weedkiller cases were among his biggest fights. He states the case as a litigator would.

He walks through the trials over the chemical glyphosate, the cancer claims of the plaintiffs, and what the firm's own papers showed. Rogan asks why regulators still allow the product on farms and lawns. The segment is an activist lawyer's brief against big agriculture, detailed and one-sided by design, kept in his own words.
